answer: Random Orchard Verification mechanism requires users to solve verifiable computation puzzles tied to unpredictable blockchain data. An attacker must expend significant computational resources to precompute solutions across the vast space of possible challenges, with each failed attempt permanently anchoring identity commitments at high cost. The system uses a cryptographic prism to ensure only genuine computational effort—not precalculation—resolves challenges, making mass fake identities prohibitively expensive.
